about: Latest live state of the Canary Wharf / Docklands zone and the last 24 hours, written by cwplans/tools/cache-londat.mjs (danbri/londat) from the history in this folder. Times: ISO UTC. Each theme keeps the licence of its source (sources).
history: cache/runs/2026-11-DD/live-*.json.gz (this month, one file per run); cache/live-YYYY-MM.sqlite (closed months)

rows: District Line: Severe delays between Earl's Court and Wimbledon and MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to train cancellations and while we deal with a signalling problem. Tickets will be accepted on London Buses and South Western Railway services via any reasonable route.

District Line: Severe delays between Earl's Court and Wimbledon and MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to train cancellations and while we deal with a signalling problem. Tickets will be accepted on London Buses and South Western Railway services via any reasonable route.
Minor delays between Paddington and Reading/Heathrow Terminals due to an earlier track fault at West Ealing. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
Jubilee Line: Minor delays southbound/eastbound due to an earlier faulty train at Canary Wharf. GOOD SERVICE northbound/westbound.
Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Harrow-on-the-Hill and Aldgate due to an earlier faulty train at Baker Street. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Piccadilly Line: Severe delays due to an earlier signal failure at South Kensington. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, Weaver line, Great Northern, South Western Railway, Weaver line and Elizabeth Line services via any reasonable route.

Suffragette Line: No service between South Tottenham and Barking Riverside, until the end of service on Tuesday 10 November, due to a operational incident. A reduced service is operating on the rest of the line. Trains will operate every thirty minutes in either direction departing Gospel Oak at xx:
Victoria Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.
